prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single original friendly dog character reference for a desktop mascot, handcrafted stop-motion plasticine/clay aesthetic. Full body, facing viewer in an easy upright seated dog posture on hind legs with two short front paws resting in front; unmistakable canine anatomy, not a human in a dog suit. Oversized expressive floppy dark chocolate brown ears, warm honey tan body, pale cream muzzle and small chest patch, round soft black nose, big friendly white eyes with dark brown pupils and small clay eyebrows, tiny relaxed smiling mouth. Slightly wonky handmade charm, smooth matte modelling clay with very subtle thumb impressions, simple readable sculpted shapes rather than furry detail. Short curved tail visible at the side. Soft even studio lighting, compact rounded silhouette. Entire character including ears, paws and tail visible, centered with generous empty margin. No clothes, no collar, no accessories, no text or logo, no floor, no cast shadow. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with alpha=0 outside silhouette. All interior clay surfaces completely opaque, especially black nose, eyes, cream muzzle and body; no transparency holes, no baked checkerboard. Produce one clean high-quality character, not a grid. This image will be the identity reference for 140 small animation frames.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: actual production animation sprite sheet for Nexirum desktop companion. The attached image is the IDENTITY REFERENCE: use this exact friendly handmade plasticine dog, warm honey tan, cream muzzle/chest/paws/tail tip, dark chocolate huge floppy ears, friendly white eyes with brown pupils, black round nose, no clothes or collar. Retain face, proportions, ears, colours, short tail and seated canine anatomy throughout, not a humanoid. Simplify clay surface texture at this small sprite size, smooth broad sculpted shapes. Create one landscape 1536 by 1024 PNG canvas with exactly TEN COLUMNS and SEVEN ROWS (70 complete separate sprites). Invisible regular grid: each cell about 153.6 by 146.3 px. Each dog about 104px wide and 116px tall, centered horizontally in its cell, paws on a common baseline within each row, wide transparent gutters. Camera fixed straight-on full-body, constant size and lighting. ALL ears/tails/paws and optional symbols inside their own cell, no inter-cell overlaps. Every row is 10 ORDERED animation keyframes of ONE behaviour, flowing from left to right, not random poses. Small controlled motion suits stop-motion plasticine. Genuinely transparent alpha background; character interiors fully opaque including all black/white/brown/cream regions. No ground, shadows, labels, text, cell borders, guides or checkerboard. Exactly 7 rows. Row1 idle: soft breathing, ears settle, one slow blink mid-row, paws stay planted, return to starting smile. Row2 thinking: eyes glance upwards, one ear folds upward at its base and other hangs, slight head tilt and back, thoughtful not sad, loop. Row3 listening: ears lift gently outward to attention, head tilts a little right then back, eyes engaged, closed mouth, loop. Row4 talking: small opening and closing smiling mouth, modest head and ear conversational bobs, return to relaxed mouth; no huge tongue, loop. Row5 happy: brighter smile, squinted happy eyes, little chest lift and tail wag, ears bounce subtly, then baseline smile, loop. Row6 warning: attentive concerned but friendly raised brows, little amber triangular exclamation icon near upper-right of each relevant pose, amber not red, small alert ear lift then relax, loop. Row7 sleep: dog remains in SAME SEATED compact full-body posture, eyes closed, head droops slightly forward, ears limp, calm breathing, no lying down, loop. Ensure each row contains ten visible poses and each retains the exact reference character.

Row2 success: small proud affirmative head nod and pleased eyes, ears perk and settle, small cyan checkmark near upper-right, last frame calm default idle, one shot. Row3 wake: begins seated asleep with eyes closed and head slightly drooped, opens eyes gradually, ears rise, modest stretch of neck while paws stay grounded, ends exact relaxed awake idle posture, one shot. Row4 hello: starts relaxed seated, lifts one front paw in a modest dog wave, floppy ears bounce slightly, puts paw back, last frame exact default idle posture, one shot. Row5 confused: tilted head, one ear raises and other droops, alternating eyebrow lift, tiny blue question mark at upper-right, return to center, loop. Row6 searching: dog looks gently left to center to right with attentive ears, tiny blue magnifying-glass icon upper-right, body/front paws remain forward, loop. Row7 working: focused calm eyes, ears angled slightly back in concentration, small head nods, tiny blue gear symbol upper-right, not angry, no keyboard or desk, same seated canine posture, loop. notes: Original clay dog: honey tan body, cream muzzle and expressive brown floppy ears.
Generated with the built-in image-generation tool. All three prompts are included.
14 states, 10 frames per state. Local processing crops, aligns and packages the generated poses.
After visual inspection, alpha endpoints were normalized from 8% to 98% to remove residual haze and make solid surfaces opaque. Colours, frame dimensions and all 140 poses were preserved.
All frames were visually inspected on light, dark and yellow backgrounds.

The project owner confirmed that the original dog package works in Nexirum Companion on 2026-10-22. This English example keeps the same atlas bytes; only presentation text and the folder/display name are changed.
